check.split: deterministic 4,000-world-unit cell hash; local interpolation, not a spatially independent extrapolation test
check.selection: route identity, initial distance <=5000, heading agreement >=0.65, along-track <=150, marker snap <=120; all selected before final model fitting
independent_bridge_diagnostics: Los Angeles port bridge candidate (identity uncertain)

natural_earth_roads.rights: Natural Earth public domain; used for calibration, not rendered as roads

calibration_source.native_observations: Read-only effective ATS/map resources; no geometry/artwork distributed with package or source bundle.

fitting.ground_loss: Inequality on typed fuel/rest/service observations using signed distance of R1 rendered water; source/raster uncertainty applies. No universal road-on-land loss.
fitting.road_loss: Normal distance to geographically identified route, allowing along-route sliding.

limits: Local held-out route samples were prefiltered using r1 and are not blind checks.
All physical-ground class observations are calibration facts; their residuals are training diagnostics.
Water-pixel diagnostics include true bridges/ports and cannot be treated as all-road land requirements.
No global alignment or exact shoreline guarantee; lake-belt and shallow Gulf regressions remain.
